title: Video intro
inspection: six evenly spaced frames visually reviewed
viewport: mobile portrait; encoded pixel dimensions are not device-point dimensions
observations: A full-screen rendered story cuts between an arena, a glowing crystal and beam, a match announcement, a character emerging through a pink portal, an orange guitar-playing character, and a crowd. Subtitles sit low in the frame.
